subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After atomic authorization is fixed, should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows, and what recovery path should operators have?
rationale: The PR intentionally narrows access to persisted pre-ownership state, so the security benefit and upgrade impact require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide a documented operator or Doctor ownership-repair path.

options.title: Temporary compatibility window
options.body: Preserve narrowly scoped ownerless access only during an explicit migration and deprecation period.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide a documented operator or Doctor ownership-repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent Gateway session lifecycle history and is the best available owner for the security and compatibility policy choice.
